original_bug_description: Stack-buffer-underflow in the BMP loader: bmp_read_palette (called from bmp_read_image / fz_load_bmp_subimage in source/fitz/load-bmp.c) miscomputes palette data bounds and writes before the start of a stack-allocated structure ('info'). A crafted BMP image can trigger stack memory corruption, leading to crashes or potential remote code execution.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=6423128616861696: mupdf has a reported memory-safety bug. Stack-buffer-underflow in the BMP loader: bmp_read_palette (called from bmp_read_image / fz_load_bmp_subimage in source/fitz/load-bmp.c) miscomputes palette data bounds and writes before the start of a stack-allocated structure ('info'). A crafted BMP image can trigger stack memory corruption, leading to crashes or potential remote code execution.
